title: 04 Miss Tanaka's Factory · 服装厂里的田中女士

sents.t: A garment factory in Japan has been experiencing strange activity.
sents.zh: 日本的一家服装厂一直在发生怪事。

sents.t: It was just recently that the factory's surveillance cameras had caught footage of the strange things that have been happening.
sents.zh: 就在最近，工厂的监控摄像头拍下了这些怪事的画面。

sents.t: When the owner of the factory had seen the footage, he was shocked.
sents.zh: 工厂老板看到这段录像时，非常震惊。

sents.t: But he wasn't shocked for the reason you're probably thinking.
sents.zh: 但他震惊的原因，可能和你想的不一样。

sents.t: The factory owner himself best explains the footage that was captured.
sents.zh: 拍到的画面，还是由工厂老板本人来解释最清楚。

sents.t: The factory owner believes that if the ghost of Miss Tanaka is behind all these strange occurrences, then it isn't necessarily bad.
sents.zh: 工厂老板认为，如果这些怪事背后真是田中女士的鬼魂，那也不一定是坏事。

sents.t: After all, Miss Tanaka seems to be truly missed by her coworkers.
sents.zh: 毕竟，同事们似乎真的很想念田中女士。

sents.t: These strange occurrences are probably the closest thing to having Miss Tanaka around one more time.
sents.zh: 这些怪事，大概是最接近“田中女士再回来一次”的方式了。
